title: Accept the branch offices' status uploads from any system

blocks.text: Branch offices upload a plain-text file of shipment statuses, one per line, and `StatusUpload.statuses(...)` turns it into a list. An unknown status rejects the whole upload, so a typo is caught before anything is booked.

The parser was written and tested on Linux. Since the offices started uploading, support keeps forwarding rejections that quote a status that looks right: `unknown status 'SHIPPED'`. Other uploads are rejected at a line that looks empty in the office's editor. The office in Osaka, whose files come from a Japanese spreadsheet export, has never had an upload accepted.

Finish the two `TODO`s in `src/main/java/practice/StatusUpload.java`: `lines(...)` and `carriesNoStatus(...)`. Any upload that holds only known statuses and lines without a status must be accepted, whichever system wrote it. About two lines in total.

cases.says: a file whose lines end in line feeds gives its statuses in order
an empty line between statuses is skipped
a file whose lines end in carriage return and line feed gives the statuses without the carriage return
a file whose lines end in a lone carriage return is split into its lines
a line of spaces and tabs carries no status and is skipped
a line of Unicode whitespace beyond U+0020, such as the ideographic space, is skipped
